column1: # Brazilian Portuguese glossary. CLAUDE-ONLY PROPOSAL, drafted 2026-11-05 alone by Claude, pending the three-vendor debate; not final. No native speaker has reviewed it.

# Same columns as en.tsv: term holds the Portuguese, forms separated by " | ", the first being the canonical one. Definitions are D3's where D3 changed them, and stay in English because they describe the en.tsv term.
# D3 merged with the English fixes (#208, 2026-11-05): the rows it retired are gone, and its new rows have Claude's proposal too.
# The Top speed / Maximum speed hold is over: en.tsv and the strings now use D3's senses (Maximum speed is the setting, Top speed the measured value), matching the rows below.

# The dashboard hold is over too: the scooter's own display has its own row (scooter-display, visor do patinete), and the dashboard row (Painel) means only Volt's Home. The few strings that still say dashboard for the scooter's display (dashboard_model_qa_dashboard_sound and its _short, main_group_dashboard_sound) use visor do patinete, per style section 7 and rule 13.
